hack.root_cause: Compound V2 empty-market donation attack — governance-added PEPE market exploited via rounding + exchange rate inflation
hack.description: Onyx Protocol lost $2.1M on Halloween when a governance vote to add a PEPE memecoin lending market created a textbook Compound V2 empty-market vulnerability — the same bug that had already hit Hundred Finance and Midas Capital earlier that year.
